P_MACRO_01_colonization_diversification_.result: 36/38 sampled Japanese species are in one dominant radiation while rare exceptional histories remain
P_MACRO_01_colonization_diversification_.why_problem: arrival count is not equivalent to diversification success

P_MACRO_02_topology_direction_identifiab.result: 270/945 rooted resolutions require regain; the rest permit a no-regain optimum
P_MACRO_02_topology_direction_identifiab.why_problem: directional trait-history claims depend on topology support, not phenotype coding alone

P_MACRO_03_species_tip_state_aggregation.basis: EAzami colour atlas + preliminary Fitch screen
P_MACRO_03_species_tip_state_aggregation.result: reviewed source-backed polymorphic taxon records=4; takaoense sample states W=3 C=3
P_MACRO_03_species_tip_state_aggregation.why_problem: one-state-per-species coding can erase within-lineage transitions

P_MACRO_04_evidence_nonindependence.result: published rows=4 but independent published data-generation groups=3
P_MACRO_04_evidence_nonindependence.why_problem: paper counts and accession rows can overstate independent replication

P_MACRO_05_phenotype_mechanism_scale_gap.basis: EAzami source-backed colour atlas + molecular literature
P_MACRO_05_phenotype_mechanism_scale_gap.result: white/polymorphic states occur across 5 reviewed phylogeny-context labels, while causal molecular mechanisms are not comparably resolved across those lineages
P_MACRO_05_phenotype_mechanism_scale_gap.why_problem: phenotypic convergence can be strong even when molecular convergence is unknown or heterogeneous

HMM1.name: latent-pathway / regulatory reversibility
HMM1.prediction: recent independent white lineages often retain structural flavonoid machinery and differ at regulatory/expression nodes more often than by shared destructive pathway loss
HMM1.falsifier: multiple well-resolved recent white lineages independently show irreversible loss/disruption of core pathway genes with no retained functional route

HMM2.name: population-aware transition-rate inflation relative to species-tip coding
HMM2.prediction: population/sample-aware coding yields more and younger W<->C transitions than one-state-per-species coding across replicated polymorphic systems
HMM2.falsifier: after topology uncertainty is propagated, population-aware coding does not increase transition count or shifts only one idiosyncratic system

HMM3.name: radiation-success / evolvability
HMM3.prediction: the dominant Japanese radiation shows higher genomic discordance/reticulation and-or faster trait or niche diversification than secondary histories after age and sampling controls
HMM3.falsifier: secondary histories show comparable evolvability metrics and diversification after age/sampling correction, leaving colonization timing/opportunity sufficient

HMM4.name: reticulation-phenotypic-transition coupling
HMM4.prediction: lineage-level gene-tree/cytonuclear discordance and ploidy/genome-size shifts positively covary with population-aware floral transition density
HMM4.falsifier: transition density is unrelated or negatively related to discordance across supported topology ensembles and leave-one-clade-out analyses

HMM5.name: phenotypic convergence / molecular heterogeneity
HMM5.prediction: convergence is stronger at phenotype/pathway/module level than at exact gene/nucleotide level across independent white systems
HMM5.falsifier: the same causal gene and homologous mutation class repeatedly explains independent white systems more strongly than module-level heterogeneity

claim_boundary: Published conclusions, EAzami reanalysis findings, and EAzami hypotheses are stored separately. Hypotheses are derived from EAzami-observed cross-scale problems; they are not copied from the future-work sections of source papers.
